title: Advisory can_delete: never, hash, now, always
severity_reason: Advisory delete works exactly as documented: 'never' blocks rotation entirely, a hash authorises up to that ledger, 'now' authorises exactly one more rotation (the gate is can_delete >= lastRotated - 1), and 'always' releases every later rotation.
notes: Advisory delete is ON, so can_delete starts at 0 ('never'). The hash argument names ledger 1200, which the node holds. 'now' sets can_delete to lastRotated at that moment; because the rotation gate is can_delete >= lastRotated - 1, that authorises exactly one more rotation. 'always' releases every later rotation. Note also that a rotation sets lastRotated to the current validated tip, not to the gate threshold, so a rotation delayed by can_delete fires late and the next interval is counted from the late tip.
